remaining_blockers.description: Some source intake/classification requires a separately deployed GAS implementation; the bundled MCP is read-only and does not supply complete cloud run/write/audit/notification operations.
Independent-user real API source-to-journal/evidence/read-back E2E, fault recovery and replay with zero additional writes are not verified. Mock tests do not waive this gate.
Final owner approval of first-party source rights, MIT terms, provider contracts and exact public contents is required. No publication was authorized.

limits: Automated patterns and focused source review cannot prove absence of every form of personal data.
The owning GitHub handle and approved noreply metadata are intentionally visible if published.
Provider brand/API names and synthetic reserved-domain examples are not private company records.
The old identifying history remains in a separate private archived repository, never in this candidate.
The test environment is a fresh virtual environment on the same authorized Mac, not an independently operated company account.
Optional integrations and all supported OS/Python combinations are not fully acceptance-tested.
